evidence_quotes: Last onder dwangsom / lozing van APFO/PFOA / gegrond.
rationale: This Dutch administrative decision (Rechtbank Den Haag) concerns an administrative enforcement order with penalty payments (last onder dwangsom) regarding the discharge (lozing) of industrial PFAS chemicals (APFO/PFOA). In Dutch environmental and water law, 'lozing' specifically denotes wastewater/effluent discharge into surface water, sewer infrastructure, or soil/groundwater. Because the dispute centers on enforcement against industrial chemical effluent pollution, both labels are WATER and the primary governance category is environmental_protection.
